ruleDefinitions.name: WinDivert Driver Load
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the load of the Windiver driver, a powerful user-mode capture/sniffing/modification/blocking/re-injection package for Windows Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: ((ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\\\WinDivert\\\.sys.*") OR ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\\\WinDivert64\\\.sys.*") OR ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\\\NordDivert\\\.sys.*") OR ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\\\lingtiwfp\\\.sys.*") OR ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\\\eswfp\\\.sys.*")) OR (process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=0604bb7cb4bb851e2168d5c7d9399087.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=2e5f0e649d97f32b03c09e4686d0574f.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=52f8aa269f69f0edad9e8fcdaedce276.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=c0e5d314da39dbf65a2dbff409cc2c76.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=58623490691babe8330adc81cd04a663.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=8ee39b48656e4d6b8459d7ba7da7438b.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=45ee545ae77e8d43fc70ede9efcd4c96.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=a1b2e245acd47e4a348e1a552a02859a.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=2a5f85fe4609461c6339637594fa9b0a.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=6b2c6f95233c2914d1d488ee27531acc.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=9f2fdd3f9ab922bbb0560a7df46f4342.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=d8a719865c448b1bd2ec241e46ac1c88.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=0ea54f8c9af4a2fe8367fa457f48ed38.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=9d519ae0a0864d6d6ae3f8b6c9c70af6.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=a74929edfc3289895e3f2885278947ae.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=a66b476c2d06c370f0a53b5537f2f11e.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=bdcd836a46bc2415773f6b5ea77a46e4.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=c28cd6ccd83179e79dac132a553693d9.*")))
